Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.domain.model

Record Class ChainProbeResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.domain.model.ChainProbeResult
Record Components:
sats - observed balance in satoshis
quality - evidence quality used by synchronization policy
authoritative - whether the source can establish an absolute current balance
outpointCount - number of outputs represented by the observation
source - stable source label for diagnostics and audit
public record ChainProbeResult(long sats, ProbeQuality quality, boolean authoritative, int outpointCount, String source) extends Record
Result of probing on-chain balance for a wallet. Carries quality metadata so writers can refuse low-quality absolute updates (partial scans, mempool-blind totals, zero spikes).
